name: tapd-client
description: TAPD enhanced desktop client with MCP support

scripts.dev: pnpm check:dsh && pnpm build:companion && pnpm build:sidecar:debug && pnpm -C apps/desktop tauri dev
scripts.build: pnpm prepare:dsh && pnpm build:companion && pnpm build:sidecar && pnpm -C apps/desktop tauri build
scripts.build:arm64: pnpm prepare:dsh && pnpm build:companion && bash scripts/build-sidecar.sh aarch64-apple-darwin && pnpm -C apps/desktop tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C apps/companion typecheck && pnpm -C apps/desktop typecheck
scripts.check:rust: pnpm build:companion && pnpm build:sidecar:debug && cargo check --workspace
scripts.test:rust: pnpm build:companion && pnpm build:sidecar:debug && cargo test --workspace
